title: Design System: Galgame Translater — 夜樱工坊

display.purpose: Brand headlines and titles. Only on marketing/brand surfaces, never in app UI.

headline.purpose: Page titles, scene titles, chapter names.

title.purpose: Card titles, dialogue character names, panel headers.

body.purpose: Reading text: dialogue, narration, descriptions. Max line length 75ch.

label.purpose: Button text, tags, nav items, metadata.

mono.purpose: Node IDs, code snippets, technical info.

shadows.name: float-low
shadows.purpose: Dark mode: dropdowns, tooltips, light floating elements.

shadows.name: float-low-light
shadows.purpose: Light mode: dropdowns, tooltips, light floating elements.

motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: Default easing for all state transitions. Exponential ease-out.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Sakura pink accent button for primary actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #ff8ba0; color: #fff; padding: 12px 28px; border-radius: 12px; border: none; font-family: 'Noto Sans SC', 'Hiragino Sans GB', sans-serif; font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.03em; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.19,1,0.22,1), transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.19,1,0.22,1), box-shadow 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.19,1,0.22,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #e6758b; transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(255,139,160,0.3); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ffb3c1; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.4; cursor: not-allowed; transform: none; box-shadow: none; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: transparent; color: #ececf4; padding: 12px 28px; border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid #2e2e3e; font-family: 'Noto Sans SC', 'Hiragino Sans GB', sans-serif; font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.03em; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.19,1,0.22,1), color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.19,1,0.22,1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: #ff8ba0; color: #ff8ba0; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ffb3c1; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Dialogue Box
components.description: Bottom-anchored VN dialogue box with gradient backdrop.
components.html:
朝仓 音梦happy

今天也是、适合赏花的一天呢。▌
components.css: .ds-dialogue { position: absolute; bottom: 0; left: 0; right: 0; padding: 64px 24px 24px; background: linear-gradient(to top, rgba(10,10,16,0.95) 0%, rgba(10,10,16,0.9) 60%, transparent 100%); cursor: pointer; } .ds-dialogue-header { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; margin-bottom: 8px; } .ds-dialogue-name { font-family: 'Noto Serif SC', Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 600; } .ds-dialogue-emotion { padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 4px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06); font-size: 0.75rem; color: #9090a8; } .ds-dialogue-text { max-width: 75ch; margin: 0 auto; font-family: 'Noto Sans SC', sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.7; color: #ececf4; } .ds-dialogue-cursor { margin-left: 2px; color: #ff8ba0; animation: pulse 1s ease-in-out infinite; } @keyframes pulse { 0%,100% { opacity: 1; } 50% { opacity: 0.3; } }

components.name: Choice Option
components.description: Clickable choice option in the VN player.
components.html:
◆去花园看看
◆留在房间里
components.css: .ds-choice { max-width: 75ch; margin: 0 auto; padding: 16px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; } .ds-choice-option { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 16px 20px; border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid #2e2e3e; background: #1e1e2a; color: #ececf4; cursor: pointer; font-family: 'Noto Sans SC', sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; transition: border-color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.19,1,0.22,1), background 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.19,1,0.22,1); } .ds-choice-option:hover { border-color: #ff8ba0; background: rgba(255,139,160,0.08); } .ds-choice-marker { color: #ff8ba0; font-size: 0.75rem; }

components.name: Node Card (Editor)
components.description: Editor timeline node card with colored type indicator.
components.html: dialoguen_001
components.css: .ds-nodecard { border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid #2e2e3e; border-left-width: 4px; background: #16161e; transition: box-shadow 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.19,1,0.22,1); } .ds-nodecard:hover { box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,139,160,0.3); } .ds-nodecard-header { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 8px 12px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-nodecard-meta { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; } .ds-nodecard-type { padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 4px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06); font-size: 0.6875rem; text-transform: uppercase; color: #58587a; } .ds-nodecard-id { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; color: #9090a8; } .ds-nodecard-actions { display: flex; gap: 4px; } .ds-nodecard-btn { background: none; border: none; padding: 4px 6px; font-size: 0.75rem; color: #58587a; cursor: pointer; border-radius: 4px; } .ds-nodecard-btn:hover { color: #ececf4; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06); } .ds-nodecard-btn-del { color: #e86868; } .ds-nodecard-btn-del:hover { background: rgba(232,104,104,0.15); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Dark-themed text input with sakura pink focus state.
components.css: .ds-input-group { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; } .ds-input { background: #0a0a10; color: #ececf4; padding: 10px 14px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid #2e2e3e; font-family: 'Noto Sans SC', 'Hiragino Sans GB', sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.5; transition: border-color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.19,1,0.22,1), box-shadow 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.19,1,0.22,1); outline: none; width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #58587a; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #ff8ba0; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(255,139,160,0.19); } .ds-input:disabled { opacity: 0.4; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Progress Bar
components.description: Upload/parse progress indicator with gradient fill.
components.html: Parsing with AI...Processing...
components.css: .ds-progress { width: 100%; } .ds-progress-label { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; margin-bottom: 8px; font-size: 0.8125rem; } .ds-progress-label span:first-child { color: #9090a8; } .ds-progress-hint { color: #58587a; animation: pulse 1s ease-in-out infinite; } .ds-progress-track { height: 4px; background: #0a0a10; border-radius: 8px; overflow: hidden; } .ds-progress-fill { height: 100%; border-radius: 8px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, #ff8ba0, #ffb3c1); transition: width 0.3s ease; } .ds-progress-indeterminate { width: 66%; animation: indeterminate-pulse 1.5s ease-in-out infinite; } @keyframes indeterminate-pulse { 0%,100% { opacity: 1; } 50% { opacity: 0.5; } }

narrative.northStar: 夜樱工坊 — 在夜色与樱花环绕中创造故事
narrative.overview:
夜色为纸，樱花为墨。这个设计系统融合了深夜的静谧与樱花的温柔，为一个将小说转化为 Galgame 的创作平台提供视觉语言。它不像工具，更像一个让人愿意停留的空间 — 打开页面就像推开一间夜色中的工坊，暖光笼罩，樱花飘落。

系统采用深色画布作为基底，樱花粉作为情感锚点，金色暖光作为氛围点缀。每一屏都是精心构图的画面，而不是功能堆砌的面板。动效是编排过的叙事节奏，而不是随意的装饰。
keyCharacteristics: 深色基底 + 樱花粉锚点 + 暖金色点缀，三色构成视觉主轴
排版优先：衬线字体用于标题和角色名，无衬线用于正文，形成情感与信息的清晰分层
动效编排：粒子系统（樱花、雪花）、光影扫过、模糊过渡、呼吸感缩放，所有动效服务于'治愈·唯美'的感受
沉浸优先：内容即装饰，背景画布和角色立绘本身就是界面
克制的信息密度：工具功能被优雅地隐藏在体验之后

rules.name: The 夜樱 Rule
rules.body: Sakura Pink 是唯一的情感色锚点。不使用第二种高饱和度色与其竞争。金色是温暖的辅助，不是第二主角。

rules.name: The Night Rule
rules.body: 所有表面都以深夜色为基底。樱花粉出现在交互元素和高亮上，从不作为大面积背景色。夜的深度是沉浸感的来源，粉色的点缀是情感的出口。

rules.name: The One-Glow Rule
rules.body: 每个页面最多只有一个主动发光源（光晕/粒子/扫光）。多个发光源会破坏夜色的静谧感。

rules.name: The 物语 Rule
rules.body: 角色名永远使用衬线字体（Display 或 Headline 级别），与正文的无衬线形成视觉区隔。角色的声音通过字体切换就能被感知。

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: 表面在静止状态下是平的。阴影仅作为状态响应（hover、聚焦、浮动）出现。面板之间的层级关系通过颜色深度表达，而非投影。

dos: 使用樱花粉作为唯一的情感色锚点，金色只作为极少量点缀
使用衬线字体（Noto Serif SC）展示角色名和标题，无衬线字体展示正文
在深色背景上使用半透明渐变叠加层确保文字可读性
为每个页面编排一个有节制的动效：页面入场渐入、元素依次出现、粒子系统作为背景层
在工具 UI（编辑器、上传页）中保持樱花粉的克制使用，避免干扰功能性
在播放器全屏模式下最大化沉浸感 — 隐藏所有非必要 UI 元素
使用颜色明度分层（night-deep → night-panel → night-card）来表达层级，而非投影
donts: 使用纯白色 (#ffffff) 或纯黑色 (#000000) — 所有中性色都带微暖色相
使用玻璃拟态（backdrop-blur 作为默认样式）
使用渐变文字（background-clip: text + gradient）
在卡片左侧使用超过 1px 的彩色竖条作为装饰性边框 — NodeCard 的 4px 彩色边框是功能性的类型标识，不是装饰
SaaS Dashboard 风格 — 没有大数字指标、没有数据表格作为主页、没有侧边栏导航图表
在同一页面使用多个发光源 — 遵循 One-Glow 规则
使用弹跳动画或弹性缓动 — 所有动效使用 exponential ease-out
嵌套卡片 — 卡片不应该嵌套在其他卡片中
在编辑器中使用模态框作为第一选择 — 优先使用行内展开编辑
